name: S-N-E-G
description: A paint for fans of S-N-E-G during the competition "Battle of the Consultants"
interestingFacts: Released on November 16th, 2012 for the competition "Battle of the Consultants".
S-N-E-G beat PagocTB in the semi-finals to move onto the finals, where he would go on to face Goliafffffff and KALASH86RUS.
The paint was bought by 17 896 players.
The paint was removed from the game after the event concluded.
